Coop Genossenschaft currently has 900 open positions published on Frontaliere Ticino, across 6 Swiss cantons. Canton ZH has the most openings (283), followed by BE (241), AG (117), GR (60), LU (52), BS (45). By city, the locations with the most open positions are Zürich (126 openings), followed by Bern (54), Basel (42), Winterthur (26), Luzern (21), Schafisheim (20). The estimated median salary for these roles is CHF 86'250 gross per year. In the last 28 days, 1449 new postings were published. 811 of the 900 active postings are part-time. Published salaries for these roles range from CHF 13'700 to CHF 198'500 gross per year. Browse the active roles below and apply directly on the employer’s own site.
